release_notes: Cage system and workflow update. NEW: full Cage toolset in Export Settings - create a cage per subgroup, live scale-adaptive Expansion / Normal-move jog sliders, Sculpt, Find intersections, Solid/Wireframe display toggle and Export Cage; the LP visibility button becomes Cage Vis/Hid when a cage exists. Create Pair now checks the LP material count: one material makes a single chapter, several materials prompt to create one chapter (split by material on Analyze HP) or several chapters - replacing the old 'Create by Mat' button and 'N_Mat' flag; Create Pair moved to a large icon button next to Pick HP/LP. UI: subgroup rows use icon buttons (eye visibility, Add, Delete, smooth +/-), redesigned cage panel with square icons, readable tooltips, Algorithm section collapsed by default. FIXES: the standalone Check button now validates frozen transforms; a red warning shows in Export Settings when the LP is not distributed. DOCS: launch prompt and an update-window button to open the illustrated PureRef manual.
